archetype: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast (Linear/Vercel Aesthetic with Premium Obsidian Edge)

typography.strategy: Swiss Brutalist meets Old Money Tech - avoiding generic sans

scales.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl tracking-tighter leading-none font-medium
scales.h2: text-3xl md:text-4xl lg:text-5xl tracking-tight leading-tight font-medium

layout_spacing.grid_strategy: Bento Grid (Mode A & B hybrid) - Dense, 1px borders, structural.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (Technical Look) - 1px borders, no shadows, extremely minimal.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Only for sticky header/nav and testimonials: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#050505]/60 border border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Minimal use. Focus on solid lines and subtle glowing borders over flat surfaces. NO purple/blue.
visual_enhancers.effects: The 'Tracing Beam' on key feature cards (projects/services). Subtle ember orange glows on hover.

components_strategy.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-none or rounded-sm), solid accent color or transparent with 1px border. Deep contrast on hover.
components_strategy.cards: Flat background (#0C0C0C), 1px solid border (#27272A). Inner padding p-8. No standard drop shadows.
components_strategy.icons: Use lucide-react (stroke-width 1.5). For tech logos, use react-icons/si.
components_strategy.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. 'Kinetic Texture' style for tech stack - clean monochrome tech logos.
components_strategy.timeline: 5-step vertical line with glowing dot indicators for the Development Process section.

motion.hover_states: Border color shifts to accent, slight background lighten, NO wild scaling.

image_urls.description: Abstract architectural 3D render of a floating glass monolith with glowing ember-orange wireframe lines
Dark cinematic modern office / server room

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly avoid any purple, violet, or cyan gradients (AI slop). Rely on Obsidian Black backgrounds with pure white text and singular Ember Orange (#F55036) accents.
Use 'react-icons/si' for the Tech Stack logos in the sliders/marquees. Install the package if missing.
Implement 'Cabinet Grotesk' for Headings, 'Manrope' for Body, and 'JetBrains Mono' for small overlines. Import them properly in CSS or index.html.
Hero Section: Use a dark grid background texture. Place the 'hero_visual' prominently. Use glassmorphism overlays if text overlaps.
Services Bento Grid: Use 'Mode A: The Tetris Grid'. 1px borders (border-white/10), flat #0A0A0A backgrounds.
Testimonials: Implement auto-scroll glassmorphism cards (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/5 border border-white/10).
Use Framer Motion for entrance animations (staggered fade-up) and Lenis for smooth scrolling.
All interactive elements MUST have 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').
Contact Form: Implement with Shadcn UI components (Input, Textarea, Button).
Ensure maximum contrast. Do not use generic drop shadows, rely on 1px borders and opacity shifts instead.

accessibility.aria_labels: Required on all icon-only buttons, tech stack icons, and social links.
